ui.natural_help_intro: Write an English sentence in the title. Recognized details fill the fields; the remaining text becomes the title.

ui.natural_help_times: at 9:30 · from 9 to 5pm · quarter to five in the afternoon. Times use your local timezone.
ui.natural_help_duration: for an hour and a half · for 1h30m · starts 12 Nov at 9am; ends 13 Nov at 5pm · all day.
ui.natural_help_location: at the office · at "Studio 54" · location: "Sofia, Bulgaria". Quote places containing dates or commas.
ui.natural_help_notes: notes: Bring ID · description: "Discuss tomorrow". Separate another field with a semicolon.
ui.natural_help_repeat: every Monday and Thursday · every other week on Friday · every last Friday of the month · for six occurrences · until 31 Dec 2027.
